Markets.title: BlackRock, SBI MF lead Tonbo Imaging’s Rs 255 crore anchor round ahead of IPO
Markets.summary: Tonbo Imaging raised Rs 255 crore from anchor investors led by BlackRock and SBI Mutual Fund ahead of its Rs 852 crore initial public offering. The entirely offer-for-sale public issue opens on October 15 and closes on October 19 at a price of Rs 700 per share.

Markets.title: US stocks: AI shares tumble up to 16%, erasing $80 billion as hot US inflation fuels rate fears
Markets.summary: US artificial intelligence stocks dropped by up to 16%, losing about $80 billion in market value due to rising inflation and interest rate concerns. Investors worry that higher rates will create borrowing difficulties for less profitable companies in the sector.

Markets.title: BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, Nomura among key investors as Zetwerk mops up Rs 2,251 crore in anchor bidding; IPO opens on Oct 15
Markets.summary: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses raised Rs 2,251 crore from 99 anchor investors, including BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, and Nomura. The company's Rs 5,012 crore IPO opens on October 15 with a price band of Rs 143 to Rs 151 per share and closes on October 19.

Markets.title: US Fed’s Bowman sees no urgency for another rate hike
Markets.summary: US Federal Reserve Vice Chair Michelle Bowman stated there is currently no urgency for additional interest rate hikes. Her comments followed a recent rate increase that established the target range at 3.75% to 4.00%.

Markets.title: Jio IPO sparks investor buzz: GMP rises to 20% as Reliance’s telecom arm announces price band, dates
Markets.summary: Jio Platforms has announced a Rs 30,213 crore initial public offering scheduled to run from October 21 to October 23, surpassing Hyundai Motor India to become the nation's largest public issue. Ahead of the launch, the company's grey market premium rose to Rs 220, reflecting a nearly 20% premium over the upper price band of Rs 1,119.

Geo-Political.title: Starlink restrictions in Ukraine war linked to political situation, Zelensky aide says
Geo-Political.summary: A Zelensky aide stated that Starlink communication restrictions in Ukraine are tied to the ongoing political situation. Elon Musk's satellite system is crucial for Kyiv to defend its airspace and direct drones toward Russian targets.

Geo-Political.title: Pope walking and recovering 'as expected' after surgery, doctors say
Geo-Political.summary: Doctors report that the 71-year-old Pope is walking and recovering as expected following a 90-minute surgery. He was diagnosed with lung cancer after the procedure on Tuesday.

Geo-Political.title: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines
Geo-Political.summary: Four years after the attacks, a Ukrainian man named Serhii Kuznetsov is on trial in Germany. He is accused of participating in the plot to blow up Russia's Nord Stream gas pipelines.

Geo-Political.title: Australia's first-ever Michelin stars go to 11 restaurants in one state
Geo-Political.summary: Australia received its first-ever Michelin stars, with 11 restaurants in South Australia earning the prestigious recognition. The state government reportedly secured the inspectors' incognito visits by funding the initiative.

Geo-Political.title: Netflix to shed 1,000 jobs in steepest cuts since 2022
Geo-Political.summary: Netflix is cutting about 1,000 jobs, which equals roughly 6% of its global workforce. This represents the streaming company's steepest layoffs since 2022.

Data & Insights.summary: India's employee attrition rate increased from 16.2% in 2025 to 18% in 2026 while salary budgets remained stable. A new study shows that artificial intelligence is transforming how companies manage their talent.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Board of directors is expanding’: Jaishankar pitches bigger role for ‘middle powers’ in changing global order
Data & Insights.summary: Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar has called for an expanded role for "middle powers" in the changing global order. This proposal follows a similar appeal by Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney for middle powers to unite in response to the decline of the US-led rules-based order.

Data & Insights.title: Piyush Goyal on China ties: India is ready to rebuild economic relations, but there's a catch
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that India is open to restoring economic relations with China. However, he emphasized that any future engagement must guarantee fair terms, continuity, and geopolitical stability.

Data & Insights.title: Why IMF’s growth upgrade for India doesn’t tell the full story
Data & Insights.summary: The IMF raised India's 2026-27 GDP growth forecast to 7 percent based on strong domestic momentum. However, currency depreciation reduced its nominal dollar GDP, temporarily dropping India behind the UK to sixth place globally.

Data & Insights.title: Wholesale inflation rises to 11.39% in September on jump in fuel, food, manufactured products prices
Data & Insights.summary: Wholesale inflation in India increased to 11.39% in September, driven by higher prices for fuel, food, and manufactured products. Specifically, the combined food index rose to 8.66% in September from 7.05% in August.

Data & Insights.title: Fixing current account deficit key to stablizing rupee: BCG's Janmejaya Sinha
Data & Insights.summary: Boston Consulting Group India Chairman Janmejaya Sinha stated that India must address its current account deficit to stabilize the rupee. He noted that the deficit is primarily driven by oil, gas, and gold imports, which the country has not yet seriously worked to fix.

India.summary: The Andhra Pradesh State Election Commission announced the schedule for the local body elections on Wednesday. State Election Commissioner Anil Chandra Punetha headed the commission that released the dates.

India.title: Terrorist Operating from Pak Declared Fugitive in Kashmir Terror Funding Case
India.summary: A Pakistan-based terrorist has been declared a fugitive in a Kashmir terror funding case involving the Al-Huda Educational Trust. The National Investigation Agency registered the case in September 2022 following the banning of Jamaat-e-Islami Jammu and Kashmir under the Unlawful Activities Prevention Act.

India.title: India's Skyroot Bags Major Private US Contract After Vikram-1 Launch Success
India.summary: US-based Reflect Orbital has purchased two dedicated rocket launches from Indian aerospace firm Skyroot. The spacecraft will be deployed to harness sunlight from space and redirect it back to Earth.

India.title: From RBI Action To Strategic Restructuring: Timeline Of IDBI Bank Stake Sale
India.summary: The Indian government has approved the strategic restructuring and sale of its controlling stake in IDBI Bank. Fairfax will acquire a 60.72 percent stake in the bank for Rs 52,878 crore.

India.summary: Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina stated that religious and ethnic minorities are living in fear due to rising attacks in the country. In a message marking Sharadiya Durgotsav, she called for national harmony and the protection of all citizens.

General.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky traveled to London to secure support from European allies after clashing with Donald Trump. British Prime Minister Keir Starmer assured him that the United Kingdom's backing remains unwavering.

General.summary: The prosecution alleges actor and comedian Russell Brand is a sexual predator at the start of his rape trial. Brand has pleaded not guilty to three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault, and one count of indecent assault.

General.title: Sally Rooney books withdrawn in UK over Palestine Action support
General.summary: Books by Irish author Sally Rooney have been withdrawn in the UK due to her support for Palestine Action. Rooney is well known for writing novels including Normal People, Intermezzo, and Conversations With Friends.

General.title: Drop-off charges at UK airports to be reviewed after sharp increase
General.summary: The UK government is reviewing airport drop-off charges following a sharp increase in fees. Officials stated the review aims to ensure travel remains accessible and passengers are treated fairly.

General.title: What we know about the Pope's lung cancer diagnosis
General.summary: The Pope underwent successful surgery to remove part of his right lung. He is currently recovering in the hospital.
